item.title: Famed Steel Guitarist Pete Finney Has Died
item.description: Steel guitarist Pete Finney has died. He was 70 years old. The admired Nashville musician performed with The Chicks, Vince Gill, the Judds, Reba McEntire, and Patty Loveless, among others. He toured with Loveless for more than 20 years.
